packageRules.description: Only stable ONNX Runtime Web releases; every update needs Matcha gates
prBodyNotes: Matcha gate: run `pnpm test:matcha-fst:tables`, `pnpm test:matcha-kaldifst-wasm`, `pnpm benchmark:matcha`, and `pnpm benchmark:matcha-stream`.

Do not merge until waveform validity, three-run RTF, initialization/stream memory snapshots, and zero underflow/append/producer errors are recorded. Target-iPhone memory remains a separate required gate.

packageRules.description: Upstream assets and native WASM toolchain require manual review
prBodyNotes: This PR is an upstream notification, not a validated asset replacement. Update download URLs, SHA-256 values, licenses/notices, and local ignored assets deliberately.
Matcha/Vocos/FST gate: verify acoustic model, Vocos, lexicon/tokens, phone/date/number FST order, 32-case golden output, valid waveform, RTF, memory, and iPhone/PWA compatibility before merge.
kaldifst/OpenFST/Emscripten gate: rebuild `pnpm build:matcha-kaldifst`, review generated dist, then run both JavaScript and WASM FST tests. Never auto-merge generated WASM changes.
